Measured myself, >= TH fold_min 5.0 (gamed only below 4.95). th = angle(J1, J3) from the built chain's own joints, margin = min(th - |a1 - a2|, a1 + a2 - th, 360 - a1 - a2 - th) (tools/concept_kit.py closure line 95, the lines 25-30 definition): min over taken poses 10.052 deg (F, 202 taken) and 10.536 deg (G, 204 taken), 0 taken poses under 5 (docs/alignment/remeasure/fold-sph3r_skeptic.json F.th_min_taken, G.th_min_taken, n_th_lt5 0). The model's own report agrees (F.model_min_margin 10.05, G 10.54), and so does the auditor's file (remeasure/fold-sph3r_claim.json F.th_margin.min_th_margin_taken_deg 10.05). It holds by construction: K.closure returns ok only where margin >= margin_deg (concept_kit.py line 96) and best_params.margin is 10.0, so no taken pose can sit under 10. The stop is on the angle the rule names (no clamp on another angle: the design has no stops).
